method: Gap indices are zero-based: gap i precedes JS call i; the final gap follows the last call. These reviewed intervals cover planning for failed actions and subsequent diagnosis/recovery. Explicit tool errors also mark their preceding and following gaps. Unreviewed silent failures remain in the other/uncertain bucket.

12-example.reason: Initial navigation and Ctrl+L failed; the rest of the run diagnosed or retried navigation.

13-wikipedia.reason: Initial navigation and Ctrl+L failed; the rest of the run diagnosed or retried navigation.

43-writer-replace.reason: Pointer click on Other options left its checked state false and panel closed. The next call used semantic activate to expand it. Gap 3 also includes planning successful form fill batched with that click; call-level timing cannot separate that planning.
